method: Static contract extraction and source/test reference inspection; no runtime outcome inferred. Contract direct/registry sets may include non-public implementation classes; explicit_format_route is restricted to public_api classes.

contract_notes: For multi-file GWF reads without an explicit channel selector, channel auto-discovery uses the first source and assumes the remaining sources contain compatible channel names.
GWpy-backed TimeSeries and TimeSeriesDict auto-identify native HDF5 for .h5 and .hdf5; structurally identified NDScope files take precedence over the generic native route.

The format-wide public_auto_identify flag remains false because it represents a uniform guarantee across every published HDF5 class family; the TimeSeries and TimeSeriesDict behavior is a class-scoped guarantee.
EventTable .root files are auto-identified by the live registry; read/write require the optional uproot backend.
Only the sdb format token and .sdb auto-identification are public.
GUI auto-load is not part of the published GBD contract because it cannot supply timezone implicitly.
The public auto-identified extension is .nc; .netcdf4 is a format-token alias, not a documented extension alias.
